normativeRationale: The immutable ECR-0007 definition of W1.A08.T02 is to qualify the actual functional product and prevent geometry drift, duplicated styling, responsive regressions and inaccessible visual states from satisfying W1 conformance. Its criteria 2 and 3 require shared, explained geometry and actual shell/panel/control measurements; criterion 4 requires independent live-product comparison and explicitly forbids visual variance from waiving accessibility or interaction contracts; criterion 5 requires affected checks and closure of blocking findings. The approved ECR-0008 execution contract explicitly returns F02 effective paragraph spacing and UX01 actual sidebar-to-footer geometry to this existing task after the exact paused-parent return, and changes only the task's effective presentation reference to approved 1.6. STYLE_GUIDE sections 1, 5, 6 and 9 permit defect restoration and require shared geometry, readable workflow controls, reachable navigation, visible focus and WCAG 2.2 AA. Against that authority, the four classified commits remove a viewport cap that violates actual footer alignment, remove additive browser paragraph margins at existing shared flow boundaries, apply the existing shared Button primitive to already-present Previous/Next/Return actions without changing their labels, conditions, targets or callbacks, and use existing approved theme tokens to repair proven contrast failures in current navigation, its numbered marker, the Application Settings eyebrow and the keyboard-visible skip link. These are bounded conformance corrections, not a new normative design: no reference, token definition, workflow order, route, domain state, security policy, native behavior, action authority, release rule or semantic 1.5 identity is introduced or changed. Where an illustrative reference accent would reproduce inaccessible normal text, the already-approved AA requirement and task criterion 4 govern; selecting an adequate existing palette token does not authorize a new theme system. Exact source-bound measurements, actual keyboard observations, adverse finding history and the separately delivered independent visual06 disposition support this classification. W1.A09's separately reviewed implementation remains inherited correction work, not retrospectively relabeled W1.A08.T02 implementation. The original task base and approved task definition remain unchanged, and this judgment neither adds forbidden experience_change/review_gate fields nor approves the task.
